releaseNotes:
Fixes

Biometric app lock no longer crashes or blocks launch
Payment capture only from known bank/Wallet apps (no Spotify / random alerts)
Update prompt and navigation no longer fail on cold start
Dark mode refreshes the Settings header and shell immediately

Improvements

Brand shown as F.F.S; version footer as V1.1.0 -N
More renamed to Settings
Light / Dark appearance toggle in Settings
Optional Bank dropdown on manual transactions
Monthly trend title layout matches Spending by category
